audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, highlighting the broad, reddish-brown carapace and the two large, robust chelipeds (claws) extended forward. The claws show characteristic white/cream coloring on the inner surfaces and red tips. The eyes are visible on short stalks at the front margin of the shell. The background is a blurred, warm-toned surface, likely a table or serving platter.
